sources.snippet: SAM ViT-B Encoder Relevant source files Purpose This document provides a technical deep-dive into the SAM (Segment Anything Model) ViT-B encoder used in DeepSeek-OCR's vision encoding system. The SAM encoder is one of two parallel vision encoders (the other being CLIP-L, see 4.3.2) that process image inputs.
